# Attachment

A file attached to a message, with its name, type and size.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Readers need sections, navigation and little else. Files attach to messages, and Content first carries no conversations: people read from start to end. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A conversation that shares files people may open or download.
- **Not when:** Uploading files in a form (a file input), or images meant to be seen inline.

Instead:

- [Message](./message.md): The message the file belongs to.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The link names the file and its type and size, not just Download. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add attachment
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
